sense_en: Used before a noun phrase, including a simple noun

ex.en: This is the time you should get up.
ex.es: Esta es la hora en que debes levantarte.

ex.en: Today is the best day of my life.
ex.es: Hoy es el mejor día de mi vida.

senses.sense_en: Used before a noun designating something considered to be unique, or of which there is only one at a time.
Used to indicate a certain example of (a noun) which is usually of most concern or most common or familiar.

sense_en: Used with past participles of verbs to form the passive voice.

ex.en: She is not what she used to be.
ex.es: Ella no es lo que solía ser.

ex.en: I thought it must be something like that.
ex.es: Pensé que debía ser algo así.

senses.sense_en: Used with present participles of verbs to form the continuous aspect.
Used with to-infinitives of verbs to express intent, obligation, appropriateness, or relative future occurrence.

sense_en: A particle used for marking the following verb as an infinitive.

ex.en: This is all you have to do now.
ex.es: Esto es todo lo que debes hacer ahora.

ex.en: It is about time you went to school.
ex.es: Fue el momento en que fuiste al colegio.

senses.sense_en: As above, with the verb implied.
Used to indicate an obligation on the part of, or a directive given to, the subject.

sense_en: Indicating destination or final position: In the direction of, so as to arrive at or reach.

ex.en: That's just what I was going to say.
ex.es: Eso es justo lo que iba a decir.

ex.en: He doesn't want to go to school today.
ex.es: Él no quiere ir hoy a la escuela.

senses.sense_en: In the direction of; towards.
Used to indicate the target or recipient of an action.

sense_en: Used simply to connect two noun phrases, adjectives or adverbs.

ex.en: Why don't you go and get your things?
ex.es: ¿Por qué no vas y traes tus cosas?

ex.en: Please tell me about you and your family.
ex.es: Por favor, háblame acerca de ti y tu familia.

senses.sense_en: Simply connecting two clauses or sentences.
Introducing a clause or sentence which follows on in time or consequence from the first.

sense_en: Introducing an epithet that indicates a birthplace, residence, dominion, or other place associated with the individual.

ex.en: I've done a lot of very bad things.
ex.es: He hecho un montón de cosas muy malas.

ex.en: I like your way of looking at things.
ex.es: Me gusta tu manera de ver las cosas.

senses.sense_en: Since, from (a given time, earlier state etc.).
From, away from (a position, number, distance etc.).

sense_en: An unspecified example of (something); the indefinite article.

ex.en: I can't do two things at a time.
ex.es: No puedo hacer dos cosas al mismo tiempo.

ex.en: We really need a man like you here.
ex.es: Realmente necesitamos a un hombre como tú aquí.

senses.sense_en: One; used before score, dozen, hundred, thousand, million, etc.
Used in some phrases denoting quantity, such as a few, a good many, a couple, a little, a bit, etc.

sense_en: To do with time; Each, per, in, on, by. Often occurs between two nouns, where the first noun occurs at the end of a verbal phrase.

ex.en: It's a long way from here to school.
ex.es: Hay una gran distancia de aquí a la escuela.

ex.en: I have a lot to say about it.
ex.es: Tengo harto que decir al respecto.

senses.sense_en: To do with separation; In, into.
To do with status; In.

sense_en: Located indoors, especially at home or at one's office or place of work.

ex.en: I want to be in the other group.
ex.es: Quiero estar en el otro grupo.

ex.en: I want to be in your life again.
ex.es: Quiero estar nuevamente en tu vida.

senses.sense_en: Located inside something.
Falling or remaining within the bounds of the playing area.

sense_en: At or towards the interior of a defined space, such as a building or room.

ex.en: This house is too small to live in.
ex.es: Esta casa es demasiado chica para vivir.

ex.en: I know he's still in love with you.
ex.es: Sé que él sigue enamorado de ti.

senses.sense_en: Towards the speaker or other reference point.
So as to be enclosed or surrounded by something.

sense_en: Contained by; inside.

ex.en: The house that I live in is old.
ex.es: La casa en la que vivo es antigua.

ex.en: Come and see me once in a while.
ex.es: Ven a verme de vez en cuando.

senses.sense_en: Within the bounds or limits of.
Surrounded by; among; amidst.

sense_en: The speaker or writer, referred to as the grammatical subject, of a sentence.

ex.en: If I can do this, you can, too.
ex.es: Si yo puedo hacer esto, tú también puedes.

ex.en: I had never seen her before that time.
ex.es: Yo nunca la había visto antes de aquella vez.

sense_en: Denoting an equal degree.

ex.en: I'm not the only one who did that.
ex.es: No soy la única persona que hizo eso.

ex.en: I'm the person who has to do that.
ex.es: Soy la persona que tiene que hacer eso.

senses.sense_en: Denoting 'as much', 'no less'.
To a great extent or degree; very, particularly.

sense_en: Introducing a clause that describes the information content of a preceding reporting noun.

ex.en: Is that what you want me to say?
ex.es: ¿Es eso lo que quieres que yo diga?

ex.en: Why are you looking at me that way?
ex.es: ¿Por qué me estás mirando de esa manera?

senses.sense_en: Introducing a clause that is the object of a verb, especially a reporting verb or verb expressing belief, knowledge, perception, etc.
As delayed subject.

sense_en: The thing, person, idea, quality, event, action, or time indicated or understood from context, especially if more remote geographically, temporally or mentally…

ex.en: I'm not sure I can do that again.
ex.es: No sé si pueda hacer eso de nuevo.

ex.en: I'm very sure I have to do that.
ex.es: Estoy segurísimo de que tengo que hacer eso.

senses.sense_en: Used to refer to a noun phrase or statement just made.
Used to emphatically affirm or deny a previous statement or question.

sense_en: Towards; in the direction of.

ex.en: I know it's been really hard for you.
ex.es: Sé que ha sido realmente duro para ti.

ex.en: There is no need for him to work.
ex.es: No hay necesidad para él de trabajar.

senses.sense_en: Leading towards in time or circumstance.
Directed at; intended to belong to.

sense_en: To possess, own.

ex.en: I didn't care what I had to do.
ex.es: No me importaba lo que tenía que hacer.

ex.en: We have a lot of work to do.
ex.es: Tenemos un montón de trabajo por hacer.

senses.sense_en: To hold, as something at someone's disposal.
To include as a part, ingredient, or feature.

sense_en: The person spoken to or written to, as an object. (Replacing thee; originally as a mark of respect.)

ex.en: Are you doing what you think is right?
ex.es: ¿Estás haciendo lo que crees que es correcto?

ex.en: Could you tell me what to put here?
ex.es: ¿Podrías decirme lo que hay que poner aquí?

senses.sense_en: The people spoken, or written to, as an object.
(To) yourselves, (to) yourself.

sense_en: The third-person singular neuter personal pronoun used to refer to an inanimate object, abstract entity, or non-human living thing.

ex.en: I don't care what other people think of it.
ex.es: No me interesa lo que otros piensen de ello.

ex.en: I put a lot of time into it.
ex.es: Invertí mucho tiempo en ello.

senses.sense_en: A third-person singular personal pronoun used to refer to a baby or child, especially of unknown gender.
Refers to someone being identified, often on the phone, but not limited to this situation.

sense_en: In the state of being active, functioning or operating.

ex.en: The light is on.
ex.es: La luz está encendida.

ex.en: The radio is on.
ex.es: La radio está encendida.

senses.sense_en: Happening; taking place; being or due to be put into action.
Of a person, used to express agreement to or acceptance of a proposal or challenge made by that person; most commonly with subject "you" (see you're on).

sense_en: To an operating state.

ex.en: I want to be on the other team.
ex.es: Quiero estar en el otro equipo.

ex.en: I don't know what to do from now on.
ex.es: No sé qué hacer de ahora en adelante.

senses.sense_en: So as to cover or be fitted.
Along, forwards (continuing an action), onwards.

sense_en: Positioned at the upper surface of, touching from above.

ex.en: What are you doing on your night off?
ex.es: ¿Qué vas a hacer en tu noche libre?

ex.en: She will care for you from now on.
ex.es: Ella te cuidará de ahora en adelante.

senses.sense_en: Positioned at or resting against the outer surface of; attached to.
Covering.

sense_en: Against.

ex.en: She had nothing to do with the case.
ex.es: Ella no tenía ninguna relación con el caso.

ex.en: I don't care what you do with it.
ex.es: No me interesa lo que hagas con esto.

senses.sense_en: In the company of; alongside, close to; near to.
In addition to; as an accessory to.

sense_en: The (thing) here (used in indicating something or someone nearby).

ex.en: Why didn't you tell me about this place?
ex.es: ¿Por qué no me hablaste de este sitio?

ex.en: Do not give this man any more money!
ex.es: ¡No le des más dinero a este hombre!

senses.sense_en: Referring to oneself.
The known (thing) (used in indicating something or someone just mentioned).

sense_en: To such an extent or degree; to the same extent or degree.

ex.en: You must take things as they are.
ex.es: Debes tomar las cosas tal como son.

ex.en: This used car is as good as new.
ex.es: Este auto usado es tan bueno como uno nuevo.

senses.sense_en: Considered to be, in relation to something else; in the relation (specified).
For example; for instance. (Compare such as.)

sense_en: In the (same) way or manner that; to the (same) degree that.

ex.en: They are as different as day and night.
ex.es: Son tan diferentes como el día y la noche.

ex.en: We need to work together as a team.
ex.es: Tenemos que trabajar juntos como un equipo.

senses.sense_en: Used after so or as to introduce a comparison.
Used to introduce a result: with the result that it is; as to.

sense_en: Introducing a basis of comparison, with an object in the objective case.

ex.en: I like this house as it is.
ex.es: Me gusta esta casa así como es.

ex.en: Try to see things as they are.

senses.sense_en: In the role of.
In the form of.

ex.es: Me lo pasé muy bien en la fiesta.

ex.en: Some of us will be at your party.
ex.es: Algunos de nosotros estaremos en tu fiesta.

senses.sense_en: Attending (an educational institution).
Working for (a company) or in (a place or situation).

sense_en: A genderless object regarded as masculine, such as certain stars or planets (e.g. Sun, Mercury, Mars, Jupiter) or certain ships.

ex.en: He is different from the people around him.
ex.es: Él es diferente de las personas alrededor suyo.

ex.en: Only time will tell if he was right.
ex.es: Solo el tiempo dirá si él tenía razón.

senses.sense_en: A person who identifies as male, or animal already known or implied.

sense_en: Negates the meaning of the modified verb.

ex.en: I'm not sure I want to see this.
ex.es: No estoy seguro de que quiera ver esto.

ex.en: I'm not sure I know what to do.
ex.es: No estoy seguro de que sepa qué hacer.

senses.sense_en: To no degree.
Used before a determiner phrase, a pronominal phrase etc. to convey a negative attitude (e.g. denial, sadness, anger) towards something.

sense_en: Along a path which runs past someone or something.

ex.en: I know him by his first name.
ex.es: Lo conozco por su primer nombre.

ex.en: By the way, where are you from?
ex.es: Por cierto, ¿de dónde eres?

senses.sense_en: In the vicinity, near.
To or at a place, as a residence or place of business.

sense_en: Near or next to.

ex.en: And by the way, how old are you?
ex.es: Y por cierto, ¿cuántos años tiene usted?

ex.en: This is by far the best way.
ex.es: Esta es por lejos la mejor manera.

senses.sense_en: From one side of something to the other, passing close by; past.
Not later than (the given time); not later than the end of (the given time interval); before.

sense_en: To a great extent.

ex.en: It's not much, but it's better than nothing.
ex.es: No es mucho, pero es mejor que nada.

ex.en: He has much more money than I have.

senses.sense_en: To a great extent.: for emphasis or to indicate a great difference
Often; frequently.

ex.en: There's so much I want to show you.
ex.es: Hay mucho que te quiero mostrar.

ex.en: That house is much better than this.
ex.es: Esa casa es mucho mejor que ésta.

senses.sense_en: Used to indicate, demonstrate or compare the quantity of something.
many ( + plural countable noun).

sense_en: However, although, nevertheless, on the other hand (introducing a clause contrary to prior belief or in contrast with the preceding clause or sentence).

ex.es: Sé cómo te sientes, pero se acabó.

ex.en: I like it, but I don't love it.
ex.es: Me gusta, pero no me encanta.

Used at the beginning of a sentence to express opposition to a remark.

sense_en: Used to indicate source or provenance.
es: de, de parte de, proveniente de

ex.en: Put it back where you got it from.
ex.es: Ponlo de vuelta de donde lo sacaste.

ex.en: What is it that you want from me?
ex.es: ¿Qué es lo que quieren de mí?

senses.sense_en: Originating at (a year, time, etc.)
Used to indicate a starting point or initial reference.

sense_en: To perform; to execute.

ex.en: This is what I can do for you.
ex.es: Esto es lo que puedo hacer por ti.

ex.en: There's only one thing we can do now!
ex.es: ¡Ahora sólo hay una cosa que podamos hacer!

senses.sense_en: A syntactic marker in a question whose main verb is not another auxiliary verb or be.
A syntactic marker in negations with the indicative and imperative moods.

sense_en: Belonging to me.

ex.en: This is where my family used to live.
ex.es: Aquí es donde mi familia solía vivir.

ex.en: I can do my job without your help.
ex.es: Puedo hacer mi trabajo sin tu ayuda.

senses.sense_en: Associated with me.
Related to me.

sense_en: An operator denoting the disjunction of two propositions or truth values. There are two forms: the inclusive or and the exclusive or.

ex.en: Which do you like better, this or that?
ex.es: ¿Cuál te gusta más, este o ese?

ex.en: Believe it or not, she has three children.
ex.es: Lo creas o no, ella tiene tres hijos.

senses.sense_en: Connects at least two alternative words, phrases, clauses, sentences, etc., each of which could make a passage true.
Used to present two or more options from which a choice is to be made.

sense_en: Excluding the person(s) being addressed. (This is the exclusive we.)

ex.es: Nosotros nos encargaremos de esto por usted.

ex.en: We all know why you did that.

senses.sense_en: Including the person(s) being addressed. (This is the inclusive we.)
The institution which the speaker/writer is acting for. (This is the editorial we, used by writers and others when speaking with the authority of their publica…

sense_en: Used before a vowel sound.

ex.en: Why do you want such an old car?
ex.es: ¿Por qué quieres un auto tan viejo?

ex.en: I'm looking for an old man.
ex.es: Estoy buscando a un anciano.

senses.sense_en: Used before /h/ in a stressed or unstressed syllable.

ex.es: No puedo agradecerte lo suficiente por tu ayuda.

ex.en: You should make good use of your time.

senses.sense_en: Belonging to you; of you; related to you (plural; more owners).

sense_en: To the (explicitly stated) extent.

ex.en: Why are you so good at doing that?
ex.es: ¿Por qué se te da tan bien eso?

ex.en: So, where do you want to do this?
ex.es: Así que, ¿dónde quieres hacer esto?

senses.sense_en: To the (implied) extent.
Very (positive or negative clause).

sense_en: As a result; for that reason; therefore; because of this; due to this.

ex.es: Así que, ¿qué es lo que quieres que haga?

ex.en: He had nothing to say, so he went away.
ex.es: Él no tenía nada que decir, así que se retiró.

senses.sense_en: Used to connect previous conversation or events to the following question.
Used to introduce a rhetorical question.

sense_en: Used after a pause for thought to introduce a new topic, question or story, or a new thought or question in continuation of an existing topic.

ex.es: Entonces, ¿qué es lo que tenemos que hacer?

ex.en: So, what do you think of her?
ex.es: Entonces, ¿qué opinas de ella?

senses.sense_en: Used as a question to ask for further explanation of something said, often rhetorically or in a dismissive or impolite manner.
Used as a meaningless filler word to begin a response to a question.

sense_en: Wholly; entirely; completely; totally.

ex.en: What have you been doing all this time!
ex.es: ¿¡Qué has estado haciendo todo este tiempo!?

ex.es: ¿Cuál fue el sentido de todo esto?

senses.sense_en: Apiece; each.
So much; used with "the" and a comparative.

ex.es: Toda la gente que estaba aquí se ha ido.

ex.en: I don't want to be up all night.
ex.es: No quiero estar levantado toda la noche.

senses.sense_en: Throughout the whole of (a stated period of time; generally used with units of a day or longer).
Only; alone; nothing but.

sense_en: To obtain; to acquire.

ex.es: Puedo conseguirte uno si quieres.

senses.sense_en: To receive.
To have. See usage notes.

sense_en: Belonging to him.

ex.en: I can't think of his name just now.
ex.es: No puedo recordar su nombre ahora mismo.

ex.en: Each person has his own way of doing things.

senses.sense_en: Belonging to a person of unspecified gender.

ex.es: Ellos ni siquiera sabían lo que habían encontrado.

ex.en: I know what they want me to do.

senses.sense_en: One whose gender is unknown, irrelevant, or both.
One who is nonbinary.

One o'clock, either a.m. or p.m.

The cardinality of the smallest nonempty set.

ex.es: Creo que he tomado uno de más.

ex.en: Why don't you try one of these?

The first mentioned of two things or people, as opposed to the other.

Used in isolation or apposition, or (sometimes proscribed) as the complement of the copula (be).

sense_en: Supposing that, assuming that, in the circumstances that; suppositive used to introduce a condition that may be (or prove to be) either true or false.

May; to be permitted or enabled to.

ex.en: I don't want to go any place.
ex.es: No quiero ir a ninguna parte.

senses.sense_en: A/an, each or some, no matter its/their identity or nature.
An unspecified but imminent (second, minute, day etc.).

sense_en: At that time.

ex.en: If you didn't put this here, then who did?
ex.es: Si tú no pusiste esto aquí, ¿entonces quién?

ex.en: I didn't know what to do then.
ex.es: No sabía qué hacer entonces.

senses.sense_en: Soon afterward.
Next in order of place.

sense_en: Used as a past subjunctive (contrary to fact).

ex.en: They could not find work at home.
ex.es: Ellos no pudieron encontrar trabajo en casa.

ex.en: I thought that we could do this together.
ex.es: Pensé que podríamos hacer esto juntos.

senses.sense_en: Used to politely ask for permission to do something.
Used to politely ask for someone else to do something.

sense_en: At or near the rear.

ex.en: Tom heard the back door open and close.
ex.es: Tom oyó que la puerta trasera se abrió y se cerró.

ex.en: We entered the room by the back door.
ex.es: Entramos en la habitación por la puerta trasera.

senses.sense_en: Returned or restored to a previous place or condition.
Not current.

sense_en: To or in a previous condition or place.
es: de vuelta, de regreso, hacia atrás

ex.en: He will be back in a day or two.
ex.es: Él estará de vuelta en un día o dos.

ex.en: She could not find her way back.
ex.es: No pudo encontrar el camino de regreso.

senses.sense_en: In a direction opposite to that in which someone or something is facing or normally pointing.
In a direction opposite to the usual or desired direction of movement or progress, physically or figuratively.

sense_en: The rear of the body, especially the part between the neck and the end of the spine and opposite the chest and belly.

ex.en: One of them hit me in the back.
ex.es: Uno de ellos me pegó en la espalda.

ex.en: I won't turn my back on you again.
ex.es: No volveré a darte la espalda.

senses.sense_en: The spine and associated tissues.
The part of a piece of clothing which covers the back.

sense_en: A road, a direction, a (physical or conceptual) path from one place to another.

ex.en: I didn't want to get in your way.
ex.es: No quería interponerme en tu camino.

ex.en: Can you find your way all right?
ex.es: ¿Podrá usted encontrar el camino sin dificultad?

senses.sense_en: A means to enter or leave a place.
A roughly-defined geographical area.

sense_en: To encounter or discover by accident; to happen upon.

ex.en: Where can I find out more about this?
ex.es: ¿Dónde puedo encontrar más información sobre el tema?

ex.en: I think I found what you're looking for.
ex.es: Creo que encontré lo que estás buscando.

senses.sense_en: To encounter or discover something being searched for; to locate.
To locate on behalf of another.

sense_en: Me (in all contexts).

ex.en: What does this have to do with us?
ex.es: ¿Qué tiene que ver esto con nosotros?

ex.en: Why don't you come to the party with us?
ex.es: ¿Por qué no vienes a la fiesta con nosotros?

senses.sense_en: Me and at least one other person, excluding the person(s) being addressed. (exclusive us.)
Me and at least one other person, including the person(s) being addressed. (inclusive us.)

sense_en: That which is considered to exist as a separate entity, object, quality or concept.

ex.en: I don't want you to change a thing.
ex.es: No quiero que cambies ni una sola cosa.

ex.en: I thought that things would get better.
ex.es: Pensé que las cosas iban a mejorar.

senses.sense_en: A word, symbol, sign, or other referent that can be used to refer to any entity.
An individual object or distinct entity.

sense_en: By or for the cause that; on this account that; for the reason that.

ex.en: I'm not going because I don't have enough money.
ex.es: No voy porque no tengo bastante dinero.

ex.en: I'm going because I want to.
ex.es: Voy porque me da la gana.

senses.sense_en: As is known, inferred, or determined from the fact that.

sense_en: Clockwise, particularly when describing a change in direction or orientation.

ex.en: You don't have the right to do that.
ex.es: No tienes derecho a hacer esto.

ex.en: His house is there on the right.
ex.es: Su casa está allí a la derecha.

senses.sense_en: Designating the side of the body which is positioned to the east if one is facing north, the side on which the heart is not located in most humans. This arrow…
Complying with justice, correctness, or reason; correct, just, true. See also the interjection senses below.

sense_en: On the right side.

ex.en: A little more to the right, just like so!
ex.es: ¡Un poco más a la derecha, así!

ex.en: I have a right to make a living.
ex.es: Tengo derecho a ganarme la vida.

senses.sense_en: Towards the right side.
Exactly, precisely.

sense_en: A legal, just or moral entitlement.

ex.en: I have every right to be here.
ex.es: Tengo todo el derecho de estar aquí.

ex.en: What is that thing in your right hand?
ex.es: ¿Qué es esa cosa en tu mano derecha?

senses.sense_en: That which complies with justice, law or reason.
The right side or direction.

sense_en: Flat and level.

ex.en: He is even older than his wife.
ex.es: Él es incluso mayor que su esposa.

ex.en: Even if you don't do that, I will.
ex.es: Aunque no lo hagas, yo lo haré.

senses.sense_en: Without great variation.
Equal in proportion, quantity, size, etc.

sense_en: In reality (used to imply an extreme example in the case mentioned).

ex.en: I don't even want to be here now.
ex.es: Ni siquiera quiero estar aquí ahora.

ex.en: I don't even want to think about that.
ex.es: Ni siquiera quiero pensar sobre eso.

senses.sense_en: Used to emphasise a comparative.
Used to indicate a further degree of comparison.

sense_en: The set of all parameters relevant to a computation.

ex.en: I have never been to the States.
ex.es: No he estado nunca en los Estados Unidos.

ex.en: Each state had just one vote.
ex.es: Cada estado tenía solo un voto.

senses.sense_en: A condition; a set of circumstances applying at any given time.
A complete description of a system, consisting of parameters that determine all properties of the system.

sense_en: In, at or to what place.

ex.en: I want you where I can see you.
ex.es: Te quiero donde te pueda ver.

ex.en: Don't you want to know where it's from?
ex.es: ¿No quieres saber de dónde viene?

senses.sense_en: In what situation.
In, at or to the place (that) or a place (that).

sense_en: To a great extent or degree.

ex.en: Very few people know how to do that.
ex.es: Muy pocas personas saben cómo hacerlo.

ex.en: It's very kind of you to say so.
ex.es: Es muy amable de usted decir eso.

senses.sense_en: Conforming to fact, reality or rule; true.
Used to firmly establish that nothing else surpasses in some respect.

sense_en: A member of the genus Homo, especially of the species Homo sapiens.

ex.en: These men are used to hard work.
ex.es: Estos hombres están acostumbrados al trabajo duro.

ex.en: I know the man you came with.
ex.es: Yo conozco al hombre con quien viniste.

senses.sense_en: An adult male human.
All human males collectively: mankind.

sense_en: Will be likely to (become or do something); indicates a degree of possibility or probability that the stated thing will happen or be true in the future.

ex.en: I don't think we should stop right now.
ex.es: No creo que debamos detenernos en este momento.

ex.en: Will you tell me what I should do next?
ex.es: ¿Me vas a decir qué debería hacer a continuación?

senses.sense_en: Used to issue an instruction (traditionally seen as carrying less force of authority than alternatives such as 'shall' or 'must').
Used to give advice or opinion that an action is, or would have been, beneficial or desirable.

sense_en: To have permission to, be allowed. Used in granting permission and in questions to make polite requests.

ex.en: I thought I might need to do that.
ex.es: Pensé que podría necesitar hacer eso.

ex.en: I thought I might be able to help.
ex.es: Pensé que podría ser capaz de ayudar.

senses.sense_en: Expressing a present possibility; possibly.
senses.es: puede que, poder ser, tal vez

senses.sense_en: Expressing a disjunctive or contrastive relation between indicative statements.

sense_en: The fifth month of the Gregorian calendar, following April and preceding June.

ex.en: Tomorrow is May first.
ex.es: Mañana es 1 de mayo.

ex.en: It can be cold here even in May.
ex.es: Puede hacer frío aquí, incluso en mayo.

senses.sense_en: A female given name, usually pet name for Mary and Margaret, reinforced by the month and plant meaning.
A surname from Middle English.

sense_en: To this place; used in place of the literary or archaic hither.

ex.en: We had some good times here, didn't we?
ex.es: Hemos pasado buenos ratos aquí, ¿a que sí?

ex.en: Are you sure you want to be here?
ex.es: ¿Están seguros de que quieren estar aquí?

senses.sense_en: In, on, or at this place (a place perceived to be close to the speaker); compare there.
At this point or stage (in a process, argument, narration, etc.)

sense_en: Actually; in fact; in reality.

ex.en: Is that what you really want to do?
ex.es: ¿Eso es lo que realmente quieres hacer?

ex.en: Do you think he will really give up?
ex.es: ¿Crees que realmente se rendirá?

senses.sense_en: In a way or manner that is real, not unreal.
Very (modifying an adjective); very much (modifying a verb).

sense_en: Indicating surprise at, or requesting confirmation of, some new information; to express skepticism.

ex.en: Have you really already found a new job?
ex.es: ¿De verdad ya has encontrado un nuevo trabajo?

ex.en: Do you really want me to do this?
ex.es: ¿De verdad quieres que haga esto?

senses.sense_en: A phatic confirmation by a listener, to signal active listening; mostly devoid of literal meaning, with the phatically contrived incredulity being merely formu…
Indicating that what was just said was obvious and unnecessary; contrived incredulity.

sense_en: Very good; excellent; wonderful; fantastic.

ex.en: The party was really great.
ex.es: La fiesta fue realmente genial.

ex.en: The food is great.
ex.es: La comida es buenísima.

senses.sense_en: Important, consequential.
Involving more generations than the qualified word implies — as many extra generations as repetitions of the word great (from 1510s).

sense_en: Likewise.

ex.en: I too would like to go see it.
ex.es: Yo también quiero ir a verlo.

ex.en: It can be done this way, too.
ex.es: También se puede hacer así.

senses.sense_en: Also, in addition marks a statement as equally valid as the preceding one.
To an excessive degree, more than enough indicates that the degree of a quality is more than what is needed or wanted.

sense_en: A cry or shout.

ex.en: Have there been any calls for me?
ex.es: ¿Ha habido algunas llamadas para mi?

ex.en: Do you know who took the call?
ex.es: ¿Sabes quién contestó la llamada?

senses.sense_en: The characteristic cry of a bird or other animal.
A beckoning or summoning.

sense_en: To request, summon, or beckon.

ex.en: I can call someone to help out.
ex.es: Puedo llamar a alguien para que ayude.

ex.en: Is that why you called me here?
ex.es: ¿Es por eso que me llamaste aquí?

senses.sense_en: To cry or shout.
To utter in a loud or distinct voice.

sense_en: An individual's performance in a sport or game.

ex.en: The play began exactly on time.
ex.es: El juego empezó a la hora exacta.

ex.en: Work while you work, play while you play.
ex.es: Durante el trabajo se trabaja y cuando se juega se juega.

senses.sense_en: Activity for amusement only, especially among the young.
Similar activity in young animals, as they explore their environment and learn new skills.

sense_en: To act in a manner such that one has fun; to engage in activities expressly for the purpose of recreation or entertainment.

ex.en: Please show me how to play this game.
ex.es: Por favor, enséñame a jugar a esto.

ex.en: I have no one to play with.
ex.es: No tengo a nadie con quien jugar.

senses.sense_en: To toy or trifle; to act with levity or thoughtlessness; to be careless.
To perform in (a sport); to participate in (a game).

sense_en: A play, dance, or other entertainment.

ex.en: I thought the show was over.
ex.es: Pensé que el show había terminado.

ex.en: The show must go on.
ex.es: El show debe continuar.

senses.sense_en: An exhibition of items.
A broadcast program, especially a light entertainment program.

sense_en: To display, convey or exhibit; to have something available for others to see; to direct attention to something.

ex.en: I have something I want to show you.
ex.es: Tengo algo que quiero mostrarte.

ex.en: Will you please show me the way?
ex.es: ¿Podrías enseñarme el camino, por favor?

senses.sense_en: To indicate; to convey facts that lead to a conclusion.
To guide or escort; to show the way.

sense_en: Inoperative, disabled.

ex.en: The television is off.
ex.es: La televisión está apagada.

ex.en: Why did you turn off the light?
ex.es: ¿Por qué has apagado la luz?

senses.sense_en: Cancelled; not happening.
Not fitted; not being worn.

sense_en: In a direction away from the speaker or other reference point.

ex.en: Why don't you take the day off?
ex.es: ¿Por qué no te tomás el día libre?

ex.en: I took a day off last week.
ex.es: La semana pasada me tomé un día libre.

senses.sense_en: Into a state of non-operation or non-existence.
So as to remove or separate, or be removed or separated.

sense_en: Not positioned upon; away from a position upon.

ex.en: There's no need to see them off.
ex.es: No hay necesidad de ir a despedirlos.

ex.en: Would you please tell me when to get off?
ex.es: ¿Me podría avisar cuándo me tengo que bajar?

senses.sense_en: Detached, separated, excluded or disconnected from; away from a position of attachment or connection to.
Outside the area or region of.

sense_en: Introducing a complete question.
es: por, por que, por la que

ex.en: Why don't you go and have a look?
ex.es: ¿Por qué no vas a echar un vistazo?

ex.en: Did he tell you why he did it?
ex.es: ¿Te dijo él por qué lo hizo?

senses.sense_en: With a negative, used rhetorically to make a suggestion.
Introducing a verb phrase (bare infinitive clause).

sense_en: At an earlier time.

ex.en: It will have been the same as before.
ex.es: Habrá sido el mismo de antes.

ex.en: I've never seen anything like this before.
ex.es: Yo nunca había visto algo así antes.

senses.sense_en: In advance in position or sequence; ahead.
At the front end.

sense_en: Earlier than (in time).

ex.en: I want to see you before you go.
ex.es: Quiero verte antes de que te vayas.

ex.en: Did someone change something here before she came?
ex.es: ¿Alguien cambió algo aquí antes de que ella viniera?

senses.sense_en: In front of in space.
In the presence of.

sense_en: A living being; the fact of a particular individual being alive. (Chiefly when indicating individuals were lost (died) or saved.)

ex.en: You're the most important person in my life.
ex.es: Eres la persona más importante en mi vida.

ex.en: What am I doing with my life?
ex.es: ¿Qué estoy haciendo con mi vida?

senses.sense_en: The state of organisms preceding their death, characterized by biological processes such as metabolism and reproduction and distinguishing them from inanimate…
The status possessed by any of a number of entities, including animals, plants, fungi, bacteria, and sometimes viruses, which have the properties of replicatio…

sense_en: A profound and caring affection towards someone.

ex.en: You're the love of my life.
ex.es: Eres el amor de mi vida.

ex.en: This love will never end.
ex.es: Este amor nunca terminará.

senses.sense_en: A deep caring for the existence of another.
Affectionate, benevolent concern or care for other people or beings, and for their well-being.

sense_en: To have a strong affection for (someone or something).

ex.en: I love you and I always will.
ex.es: Te quiero y siempre te querré.

ex.en: He can't understand what it is to love someone.
ex.es: No puede entender lo que es amar a alguien.

senses.sense_en: To need, thrive on.
To seek the good or honor of (someone), care deeply about, to be dedicated to (someone or something).

sense_en: Not moving; calm.

ex.en: Hold still for a moment, please.
ex.es: Estese quieto un momento, por favor.

ex.en: The only thing you have to do is stay still and not say anything.
ex.es: Lo único que tienes que hacer es quedarte quieto y no decir nada.

senses.sense_en: Not effervescing; not sparkling.
Uttering no sound; silent.

sense_en: Up to a time, as in the preceding time.

ex.en: There's still a lot of work to do.
ex.es: Aún hay mucho trabajo por hacer.

ex.en: He is still too young for the job.
ex.es: Él aún es demasiado joven para este trabajo.

senses.sense_en: Without motion.
To an even greater degree. Used to modify comparative adjectives or adverbs.

sense_en: A period of calm or silence.

ex.en: Is that still my room?
ex.es: ¿Sigue siendo mi habitación?

ex.en: I don't know if I still have it.
ex.es: No sé si todavía lo tengo.

senses.sense_en: A photograph, as opposed to movie footage.
A single frame from a film.

sense_en: A playful activity that may be unstructured; an amusement or pastime.

ex.en: What time will the game start?
ex.es: ¿A qué hora empezará el juego?

ex.en: This is not a game.
ex.es: Esto no es un juego.

senses.sense_en: An activity described by a set of rules, especially for the purpose of entertainment, often competitive or having an explicit goal.
A school subject during which sports are practised.

sense_en: At no time; on no occasion; in no circumstance.

ex.en: They had never seen our house before.
ex.es: Ellos nunca antes han visto nuestra casa.

ex.en: I've never seen one of these before.
ex.es: Nunca he visto uno de estos antes.

senses.sense_en: Not at any other time; not on any other occasion; not previously.
Negative particle (used to negate verbs in the simple past tense; also used absolutely).

sense_en: before a countable noun: A large, indefinite number of.

ex.en: There are many people that don't like me.
ex.es: Hay muchas personas a quienes no les gusto.

ex.en: There are many bad people in the world.
ex.es: Hay muchas malas personas en el mundo.

senses.sense_en: before a countable noun: (in combinations such as 'as many', 'so many', 'this many') Used to indicate, demonstrate or compare the number of people or things.

sense_en: Having great duration.

ex.en: Well, the night is quite long, isn't it?
ex.es: Bueno, la noche es muy larga, ¿no?

ex.en: It was too long.
ex.es: Era demasiado largo.

senses.sense_en: Having much distance in space from one end to the other.
Specifically, having much distance in a horizontal dimension (see also Usage Notes below).

sense_en: Over a great distance in space.

ex.en: This is going to be a long night.
ex.es: Va a ser una larga noche.

ex.en: We have a long story to tell you.
ex.es: Tenemos una larga historia para contarte.

senses.sense_en: Over too great a distance, beyond the target.
For a particular duration (specified by additional qualifying words accompanying it).

sense_en: A long vowel.

ex.en: This is going to be a long story.
ex.es: Esta va a ser una historia larga.

ex.en: I've got a long way to go.
ex.es: Tengo un largo camino por delante.

senses.sense_en: A long syllable.
A note formerly used in music, one half the length of a large, twice that of a breve.

sense_en: The subjective human experience, regarded collectively; human collective existence; existence in general; the reality we live in.

ex.en: I have the best job in the world.
ex.es: Tengo el mejor trabajo del mundo.

ex.en: We have all the time in the world.
ex.es: Tenemos todo el tiempo del mundo.

senses.sense_en: The subjective human experience, regarded individually.
A majority of people.

sense_en: The beginning of an activity.

ex.en: We were friends right from the start.
ex.es: Nos hicimos amigos desde el principio.

ex.en: I knew it from the start.
ex.es: Lo sabía desde el comienzo.

senses.sense_en: A sudden involuntary movement.
The beginning point of a race, a board game, etc.

sense_en: To set in motion.

ex.en: We are going to start with the women.
ex.es: Vamos a empezar por las señoras.

ex.en: I don't know where to start looking.
ex.es: No sé por dónde empezar a buscar.

senses.sense_en: To begin.
To ready the operation of a vehicle or machine.

sense_en: To attempt; to endeavour. Followed by infinitive.

ex.en: You must try and come to the party.
ex.es: Debes tratar de venir a la fiesta.

ex.en: I think it's better not to try it.
ex.es: Creo que es mejor no intentarlo.

senses.sense_en: To make an experiment. Usually followed by a present participle.
To put to test.

sense_en: Very elevated; extending or being far above a base; tall; lofty.

ex.en: The price of the car is too high.
ex.es: El precio del auto es muy alto.

ex.en: The price of this camera is very high.
ex.es: El precio de esta cámara es muy alto.

senses.sense_en: Relatively elevated; rising or raised above the average or normal level from which elevation is measured.
Of a ball, above the batter's shoulders.

sense_en: A high point or position, literally (as, an elevated place; a superior region; a height; the sky; heaven) or figuratively (as, a point of success or achievemen…

ex.en: The stock reached its high point last July.
ex.es: Las acciones alcanzaron su punto más alto el julio pasado.

ex.en: It's about time somebody did something about the high cost of medical care.
ex.es: Ya era hora de que alguien hiciera algo con el alto coste del cuidado médico.

senses.sense_en: The maximum atmospheric temperature recorded at a particular location, especially during one 24-hour period.
A period of euphoria, from excitement or from an intake of drugs.

sense_en: To instruct or inform.

ex.en: I'm going to tell you what I think.
ex.es: Te voy a decir lo que pienso.

ex.en: I'm not going to tell you my name.
ex.es: No te voy a decir mi nombre.

senses.sense_en: To determine the number, amount, or value of [something].
To notice, discern. (Roughly, "can tell" means "know" but with a sense of direct perception.)

sense_en: Facing downwards.

ex.en: She is down with a cold.
ex.es: Ella está en cama por un resfriado.

ex.en: You shouldn't look down on a person for being poor.
ex.es: No deberías mirar por encima del hombro a una persona por ser pobre.

senses.sense_en: At a lower level than before.
Sad, unhappy, depressed, feeling low.

sense_en: From a higher position to a lower one; downwards.

ex.en: Just get down here.
ex.es: Limítate a bajar por aquí.

ex.en: Please help me take this down.
ex.es: Por favor, ayúdame a bajar esto.

senses.sense_en: To or towards what is considered the bottom of something, irrespective of whether this is presently physically lower.
At a lower or further place or position along a set path.

sense_en: From one end to another of (in any direction); along.

ex.en: Please write down what I'm going to say.
ex.es: Por favor, apunta lo que voy a decir.

ex.en: Would you please turn down the TV?
ex.es: ¿Podrías bajarle a la tele, por favor?

senses.sense_en: From the higher end to the lower of.
From north to south of.

sense_en: Final, ultimate, coming after all others of its kind.

ex.en: It was last week.
ex.es: Pasó la última semana.

ex.en: That's why your name is last on my list.
ex.es: Por eso tu nombre es el último en mi lista.

senses.sense_en: Most recent, latest, last so far.
Farthest of all from a given quality, character, or condition; most unlikely, or least preferable.

sense_en: To endure, continue over time.

ex.en: About how long is it going to last?
ex.es: ¿Cuánto va a durar más o menos?

ex.en: How long do you think this money will last?
ex.es: ¿Cuánto tiempo crees que durará este dinero?

senses.sense_en: To hold out, continue undefeated or entire.
To shape (an item of footwear such as a boot or shoe) during its manufacture or repair while it is placed on a last (noun etymology 3, noun sense 1).

sense_en: Action given to provide assistance; aid.

ex.en: Do you want our help or don't you?
ex.es: ¿Quieres nuestra ayuda o no?

ex.en: I'm not sure you can be of much help.
ex.es: No estoy seguro de que puedas ser de mucha ayuda.

senses.sense_en: Something or someone which provides assistance with a task.
Documentation provided with computer software that could be accessed using the computer.

sense_en: To provide assistance to (someone or something).

ex.en: Is there anything I can do to help?
ex.es: ¿Hay algo que pueda hacer para ayudar?

ex.en: I'm not sure that I can help you.
ex.es: No estoy segura de que pueda ayudarte.

senses.sense_en: To assist (a person) in getting something, especially food or drink at table; used with to.
To contribute in some way to.

sense_en: Passing from one side of something to the other.

ex.en: I've been through a lot.
ex.es: He pasado por mucho.

ex.en: I know what they're going through.
ex.es: Sé por lo que están pasando.

senses.sense_en: Finished; complete.
Along the course of a task etc.; used in expressions of progress towards the end.

sense_en: By way of the interior.

ex.en: No one needs to go through this.
ex.es: Nadie necesita pasar por esto.

ex.en: I understand what you're going through.
ex.es: Sé por lo que estás pasando.

senses.sense_en: By way of an opening.

senses.sense_en: The act of conveying or removing something from one place, person or thing to another.
